hero_title: Write about the society you're already inside.
hero_subtitle: A peer-reviewed journal by and for MA students at JNU. Anyone can submit, on any subject that carries a sociological argument — there is no fixed topic on your thinking.
issue_note: Open submissions — published as soon as they clear review
submit_intro_1: We publish essays, field notes, review essays and photo essays — on whatever you're currently thinking about. Term papers are welcome, but rewrite them for a reader who is not your examiner:
submit_intro_2: Writing in Hindi is accepted. If a piece is accepted in Hindi we publish it in Hindi, with an English summary.

submit_specs.label: Images
submit_specs.value: Your own, or clearly licensed for reuse - please share the link for google photos, publicly accessible.
